messages.subject: when a-parameter is negative
parts:
Hi,Phil

When I try like this,

result<-mirt(data,2,method="EM")

In this model,when  a-parameter is negative, can I fix a-parameter "0"?

thanks,

Yutaro.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: when a-parameter is negative
parts:
You don't want to fix a slope to arbitrarily be greater than 0 in an exploratory factor analysis model. You could specify a confirmatory loading patter explicitly with a mirt.model() definition, but I would generally advise against imposing box-constraints (unless you know what you're doing). 

Phil
